'''2013 Alderaan Regionals Ryan Jellison DS Imperial Entanglements''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Jellison]] at [[2013 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Entanglements / No One To Stop Us This Time (Virtual Block 1)|VB1-D-imperialentanglements-pre.gif|label=Imperial Entanglements / No One To Stop Us This Time}}
* '''Username:''' sac89837
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
